parameter_interpretation.manning_scale: One global multiplier on each reach's independently estimated minutes-based Manning roughness.
parameter_interpretation.width_scale: One global multiplier on each reach's independently estimated rectangular channel width.
parameter_interpretation.slope_scale: One global multiplier on each reach's independently estimated longitudinal bed slope.
parameter_interpretation.lateral_inflow_fraction: One effective distributed reach-gain fraction applied only where measured point flows are absent; it is not a measured tributary hydrograph.

method.split_policy: Parameters are selected only from two 2002 Colorado River events and the January 2017 Truckee River event. January 2004 Colorado and February 2017 Truckee are validation. July 2004 Colorado and the predeclared Rio Grande event are test-only. All events are historical and have now been inspected; this diagnoses spatial transfer but is not prospective validation.

parameter_diagnostics.interpretation: A boundary hit means the tested range did not bracket an optimum. Geometry, slope, roughness, and lateral gain may compensate for one another; selected values are effective model parameters until supported by independent measurements.

leave_one_group_out.interpretation: Each fold selected global parameters without any event from the reported group, then scored every held-out event once.
